stacksmith.tooltip.get: Put the item in your inventory, like the creative menu does. Works on any server in creative, no op needed, any size.
stacksmith.tooltip.copy_give: Copy the /give command to the clipboard.
stacksmith.tooltip.copy_data: Copy the item as saved data ({id:...,components:{...}}), for /data, loot tables or other items.
stacksmith.tooltip.run_too_long: The command is %s characters; chat takes 256. Use Get item, or paste it into a command block.
stacksmith.tooltip.run_no_permission: This server doesn't let you use /give. Get item still works in creative.
stacksmith.tooltip.length_ok: Characters in the command. Chat takes up to 256.
stacksmith.tooltip.length_long: Too long to type in chat (256). Get item has no limit; a command block takes up to 32500.
stacksmith.tooltip.get_spawner: A spawner item that places this spawner (needs op on servers).
stacksmith.tooltip.get_command_block: A command block that turns itself into this spawner as soon as you place it: always active, no redstone. Needs op and command blocks enabled.
stacksmith.tooltip.place: Run /setblock where you look. Looking at a spawner replaces it; otherwise the spawner goes against the face you look at. This tab then saves to that block.
stacksmith.tooltip.place_no_permission: This server doesn't let you use /setblock.
stacksmith.tooltip.place_too_long: One piece of this spawner (a single name or text) is too long to send from chat. Use Get command block instead.
stacksmith.tooltip.copy_summon: Copy /summon of this mob to the clipboard.
stacksmith.tooltip.import_block: Look at a spawner first. Operators get its full data; others get what the client sees (the shown mob).
stacksmith.tooltip.get_egg: A spawn egg that makes exactly this mob. Needs creative mode.
stacksmith.tooltip.get_egg_none: This type has no spawn egg. Use Summon here or Copy /summon.
stacksmith.tooltip.summon_no_permission: This server doesn't let you use /summon. The spawn egg still works in creative.
stacksmith.tooltip.summon_too_long: Too long to send from chat (256). Use the spawn egg, Get command block, or Copy /summon.
stacksmith.tooltip.to_spawner: Start a spawner with this mob (opens the Spawner tab).
stacksmith.tooltip.save_spawner: Overwrite the spawner at %s with these settings (/setblock).
stacksmith.tooltip.load_looked_at: Load the spawner under your crosshair; saving then overwrites it. Tip: pressing J while looking at a spawner does this too.
stacksmith.tooltip.load_looked_at_none: Look at a spawner first (close this screen, aim, press J).
stacksmith.tooltip.reset_spawner: Back to this spawner as it was when you loaded it, undoing your edits. Overwrite then puts that back in the world.
stacksmith.tooltip.reset_spawner_none: Only for a spawner loaded from the world (look at it and press J).
stacksmith.msg.reset_spawner: Back to the spawner as it was loaded
stacksmith.tooltip.get_command_block_mob: A command block that summons this mob on top of itself as soon as you place it (no 256-character chat limit). The block stays; break it after. Needs op and command blocks enabled.
